title: Monsoon Mega Blood Drive
summary: Our flagship quarterly drive, run with Sassoon General Hospital and four partner clubs across two collection points.
description: The monsoon drive is the hardest one of the year to fill — travel is difficult and deferral rates climb. We run it anyway, because hospital reserves are at their thinnest in August. Two collection points, a paired-buddy system for first-time donors, and a live queue estimate published every hour.
highlights: First-time donors paired with a volunteer buddy
Refreshments and post-donation rest bay on site

title: Anganwadi Refurbishment — Centre 15
summary: Structural-first refurbishment of the Wadgaon Sheri centre: water, sanitation and safety before a single wall gets painted.
description: The fifteenth centre in the programme. As always, work proceeds in the fixed order — water, sanitation, safety, light, storage, surfaces — with the sevika walking the site with us before anything is bought. Volunteers should expect physical work and closed-toe shoes.
highlights: Structural walkthrough with the centre sevika at 08:00
Plumbing and latch repairs before cosmetic work
Six-month revisit scheduled on the spot

title: Placement Sprint — Mock Interviews
summary: A full day of one-on-one mock interviews for final-year students from three partner colleges, run by working professionals.
description: Twenty-four interviewers across engineering, finance, design, law and operations. Each student gets two forty-minute interviews with written feedback delivered within 48 hours. Open to students from partner colleges and, subject to slots, to any final-year student in the district.
venue: MCCIA Trade Tower, Senapati Bapat Road

title: Mula-Mutha River Cleanup — Phase 4
summary: Fourth phase of the riverbank recovery drive, coordinated with the municipal corporation's waste-handling team.
description: Phase 4 covers the stretch between Bund Garden and Yerwada bridge. Segregation happens on site — dry waste to the recycler, wet to the municipal pickup — so the material we lift does not simply move to a landfill. Gloves, grabbers and bags provided.

title: RYLA 3131 — Leadership Lab
summary: A two-day residential leadership programme for 80 delegates from across the district, hosted by our club this year.
description: Rotaract Youth Leadership Awards, hosted by RAC Pune Metro for RID 3131. Two residential days built around running a real project end to end: a live brief on Saturday morning, execution overnight, and a review panel on Sunday. Delegates are nominated by their clubs.
highlights: District review panel on day two

title: 22nd Charter Anniversary & Installation
summary: The club's charter night — annual report, awards, and the installation of the incoming board.
description: Twenty-two years since charter. The evening opens with the year's audited report and project review, followed by service awards and the installation of the 2027-28 board. Alumni, partner clubs and family are welcome; the club covers guest seating.

title: Literacy Circle — Term Close
summary: Closing session of the Kothrud literacy circle term, with reading assessments and a small library handover.
description: The Saturday literacy circle closes its term with individual reading assessments and a handover of 240 age-graded books to the two partner municipal schools.

title: Urban Tree Census Walk
summary: Monthly geotagging walk adding the Aundh and Baner wards to the club's urban-canopy dataset.
description: A quiet, early-morning walk with a shared form. Volunteers record species, girth, condition and a named caretaker for every sapling in the ward. The dataset is published openly each quarter.

title: Virtual Twinning Summit — Colombo & Nairobi
summary: A joint session with our twin clubs to scope two collaborative projects for the coming year.
description: Three clubs, three time zones, one agenda: pick two projects we can genuinely run together rather than five we will announce and abandon.

title: Open Books — Q4 Public Review
summary: Quarterly public presentation of the club's receipts, project-level spend and closing balance.
description: Anyone may attend. The treasurer presents receipts by source, expenditure by project and the closing balance, then takes questions on the record.
